restartBanner.pluginChangesWillTakeEffect: Plugin changes will take effect after a server restart.

pluginSigning.title: Plugin signatures
pluginSigning.description: Uploaded plugins run inside the server, so a production server accepts only plugin packages signed with a trusted key.
pluginSigning.warning: Switching this on lets the server install and load plugin packages that are unsigned, changed after signing or signed with an unknown key. Anyone who can upload a package can then run code on the server. Switch it on only for packages you have checked yourself.
pluginSigning.notSeeded: The {key} setting has not been seeded yet, so it cannot be changed here.
pluginSigning.active: Unsigned plugins are being accepted. The server no longer proves who made an uploaded plugin.
pluginSigning.label: Allow unsigned plugins
pluginSigning.hint: Off by default. A change applies to the next upload at once, and to plugins that are already installed after the next server restart. Every change is written to the activity log. A server in development mode always accepts unsigned plugins.

plugins.confirmRemoveMessage: The plugin {id} will be removed from the server. Its settings and stored data are kept, so installing it again restores them. You can purge the data afterwards.
plugins.confirmPurgeMessage: All settings and stored data of the plugin {id} will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
plugins.confirmDowngradeMessage: This version is older than the installed one. Downgrading can break data written by the newer version.
plugins.pluginStaged: Version {version} uploaded and staged. It replaces the installed version after the server restarts.

pluginSlotWidgets.title: Slot widgets: {plugin}
pluginSlotWidgets.description: Widgets that plugins add to pages. Choose the products a widget shows for; leave it empty to follow the plugin's own product list.
pluginSlotWidgets.noProducts: No products chosen: the plugin's own product list applies.
pluginSlotWidgets.orphaned: This widget is bound to products that no longer exist, so it is shown nowhere. Choose products again, or clear the binding to follow the plugin's own list.

keptData.title: Removed plugins with kept data
keptData.description: Removing a plugin keeps its settings and stored data. Purge the data only when you will not install the plugin again.

rules.ManifestVersionUnknown: The manifest version is not one this server reads.
rules.SdkAssemblyOutdated: The plugin was built against an older SDK version than this server uses.
rules.PermissionUnknown: A client entry names a permission that does not exist.
rules.AdminPermissionDeclared: An admin entry declares a permission, but the admin area takes none.
rules.RoutePathInvalid: A route path is not valid: use lowercase segments and parameters only.
rules.RouteDuplicate: The same method and route path is declared twice.
rules.LabelKeyMissing: A text key used by the plugin is missing from its English texts.
rules.SlotUnknown: A widget names a slot this server does not offer.
rules.SlotContextKeyNotOffered: A widget asks for a context value its slot does not offer.
rules.AssemblyUnreadable: A file in the plugin folder could not be read.
rules.SlotWidgetIdInvalid: A widget id is not valid: use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
rules.SlotWidgetDuplicate: The same widget id is declared twice for one slot.
rules.PluginIdInvalid: The plugin id is not valid: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens.
rules.EndpointsNotDeclared: The plugin declares routes, pages or slots, but it is not an app plugin and does not declare the endpoints capability.
rules.CapabilityNotAllowed: The plugin declares a capability this server does not know or its plugin type cannot carry.
